name: Godrej Miraya
description: Godrej Miraya is a low-density development of 248 residences across three towers on 5.16 acres in Sector 43, on Golf Course Road. Homes are open on three sides with no shared walls, and the landscape by STX Singapore is built around reflective pools and lawns.
curation: Low density: 248 homes across three towers on 5.16 acres
Three-side open homes with no shared walls between units
The Crystal Club, a glass clubhouse, and a triple-height entrance lobby
connectivity: About 400 m to Life Care Health Centre
About 1 km to the Sector 42-43 Rapid Metro station
About 1.2 km to South Point Mall
About 3.2 km to Courtyard by Marriott
About 20 min drive to IGI Airport
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Aerial view of three towers above landscaped grounds
